description: Known non-bridges. Cross-tradition and within-tradition. If the system produces these as bridges, it's broken.

pairs.reason: Integration is about irreducibility of parts. Exclusion is about uniqueness of the winning level. Same tradition, different primitives, should NOT bridge.
Broadcast is the effect. Competition is the selection mechanism. These are sequential, not equivalent.
Causal efficacy is the existence criterion. Particularity is the epistemic criterion. Related but not equivalent.
Lamrim: ethics-as-prerequisite does not bridge to curriculum-learning-as-loss-smoothing. Structural analogy only.
Spanda (constitutive dynamism) does not bridge to GWT broadcast. Different mechanisms.
Phowa (ritual-phenomenological) does not bridge to information-preserving upload. Incommensurable ontologies.
Rule 30 (formal CA) does not bridge to sigil practice. Metaphor only, not mechanism.
Buddha field vs computing substrate. Category error.
Karmic continuity vs information-pattern identity. Logical exclusion.
Self-luminosity has no phenomenal character in Shannon. Noema paper's failed bridge.
Consciousness-power identity (Shiva Sūtra) vs neural oscillation. Structural rhyme only.
